home.title: Cross-Border Diagnostic
home.subtitle: Enter your website and target market to get a comprehensive cross-border health report
home.platformsNote: Supports WordPress, Shopify, Wix, custom builds, and more

thinking.workbenchSubtitle: Full check of your site's technical foundation, conversion experience, and tracking
thinking.introBubble: I'll check this website stage by stage and compile the findings into an actionable diagnostic report. The stage currently being checked expands automatically with live progress, and you can open any stage at any time to view details.
thinking.reportGeneratedBody: The full report is ready. Open the report page to see issues, impact, fix steps, and verification methods.
thinking.runningHint: Checking now — conclusions update automatically when finished.
thinking.moduleDoneNoDetails: Check complete, no details to show
thinking.moduleDoneNoIssues: Check complete, no critical blockers found
thinking.moduleDoneIssues: Check complete, found {{count}} issues to address
thinking.moduleErrorDetail: The automated check could not complete. Review the manual re-check suggestions in the full report, or start a new diagnosis.
thinking.runningPositioning: Identifying site positioning and product messaging
thinking.targetAudienceUnknown: Target audience: to be confirmed in the report
thinking.valuePropositionPending: Value proposition: to be determined during report generation
thinking.reportGeneratedDetail: Full diagnostic report generated, including issue impact, fix steps, verification methods, and references.
thinking.streamError: Something went wrong during diagnosis, please retry
thinking.backgroundFailed: Background diagnosis did not complete, please retry

positioning.title: Identify Site Positioning
positioning.scope: Read page title, core copy, and product messaging
positioning.detail: First determines what the site sells, who it's for, and whether the value proposition is clear.

technical.title: Check Speed & Technical Foundation
technical.scope: CDN, TTFB, HTTP/2/3, images, and caching
technical.detail: Focuses on cross-border access speed and whether baseline performance undermines ad traffic landing.

landing.title: Check Landing Page Trust & Conversion
landing.scope: Form security, trust elements, redirects, and lead capture
landing.detail: Assesses whether visitors are willing to keep exploring, inquire, or submit a lead after arriving.

content.title: Check Product Content Completeness
content.scope: Product descriptions, images, videos, specs, scenarios, and localization
content.detail: Checks whether product pages sufficiently support overseas users' understanding and trust.

tracking.title: Check Forms & Ad Tracking
tracking.scope: GA4, ad pixels, conversion events, and cookie compliance
tracking.detail: Checks whether campaign performance is measurable and form leads are tracked correctly.

report.title: Generate Diagnostic Report
report.scope: Compile issues, impact, fix steps, and verification methods
report.detail: The report keeps a complete how-to guide so you can fix step by step and re-run the check.

history.title: Diagnostic History
history.emptyDesc: You haven't performed any website diagnosis yet. Go to the home page to start.
history.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete this record? This action cannot be undone.

report.roadmapSubtitle: A phased action plan based on diagnosis results, prioritizing high-impact, low-effort items.
report.disclaimerText: This report is generated by an automated system for reference only. Actual results may vary depending on website architecture, traffic volume, and target market regulations. A/B testing and local legal consultation are recommended before major changes.

verify.label: How to verify fixes

techOrder.label: Technical execution order
techOrder.message: Please turn this report into a prioritized technical execution plan, as specific as possible.
